title: GraphQL introspection result disclosed in a response
description: The response body is a GraphQL introspection result: it carries a __schema object with a queryType entry. Introspection enumerates every type, field, argument and deprecated field the schema exposes, which removes schema guessing from an attacker's work and can reveal administrative mutations.
remediation: Disable introspection in production (or allow it only for authenticated tooling) and keep the schema in the build pipeline where it belongs.
limitation: Two body markers. A GraphQL error response or a page that quotes a schema fragment is not reported unless both markers appear.

observation.body: Use __schema to explore the API during development.
